successful_niches.description: Analysis of biomarkers associated with breast cancer subtypes
successful_niches.lessons: Literature synthesis agents achieved high quality. Broad initial sweep then narrowing specialization worked well. ~140 agents fired in first run, produced breast cancer marker output.

fitness_evaluation_criteria.novelty: Finding is not a direct restatement of content in the seeded literature corpus
fitness_evaluation_criteria.plausibility: Consistent with known cancer biology; cites supporting evidence
fitness_evaluation_criteria.actionability: Suggests a specific, testable experiment or intervention with named targets
fitness_evaluation_criteria.specificity: Names specific genes, pathways, compounds, or tumor subtypes

evolution.mutation_prompt: Review the ancestor_performance section. Identify the lesson most likely to improve the next generation's token efficiency or output quality. Propose one targeted mutation to this contract's thresholds or resource_priorities that addresses it. Return only the mutation as a JSON patch object.
